-  type Func := Func(String, Bool, Vec(Param), String, Vec(Clause))
+  # a function carries its `forall` type variables (names); a bare-tvar return

@@ -124,9 +129,29 @@ mod SelfhostRust do
   # `rust_program` emits plain `fn` for every top-level function (a single Rust
   # module; the `pub?` flag is not a Rust visibility here), so it is ignored.
   def function_rs(Func) String
-  def function_rs(Func(name, _, params, ret, clauses)) :=
-    "fn " <> name <> "(" <> param_decls(params) <> ") -> " <> ret <> " {\n    match " <>
-      scrut(params) <> " {\n" <> arms(clauses) <> "    }\n}"
+  def function_rs(Func(name, _, tvars, params, ret, clauses)) :=
+    "fn " <> name <> generics(tvars) <> "(" <> param_decls(params) <> ") -> " <> ret <>
+      " {\n    match " <> scrut(params) <> " {\n" <> arms(clauses, ret, tvars) <> "    }\n}"
+
+  # `<T: Clone, U: Clone>` for a generic fn (every tvar is `Clone`-bounded so a
+  # borrowed `&T` can be cloned to the owned `T` a return wants); empty otherwise.
+  def generics(Vec(String)) String
+  def generics([]) := ""
+  def generics(tvars) := "<" <> clone_bounds(tvars) <> ">"
+
+  def clone_bounds(Vec(String)) String
+  def clone_bounds([t]) := t <> ": Clone"
+  def clone_bounds([t | rest]) := t <> ": Clone, " <> clone_bounds(rest)
+
+  def member(String, Vec(String)) Bool
+  def member(_, []) := false
+  def member(x, [y | rest])
+    if x == y do
+      true
+    else
+      member(x, rest)
+    end
+  end
 
   def param_decls(Vec(Param)) String
   def param_decls([]) := ""
@@ -143,13 +168,25 @@ mod SelfhostRust do
   def param_names([Param(n, _)]) := n
   def param_names([Param(n, _) | rest]) := n <> ", " <> param_names(rest)
 
-  def arms(Vec(Clause)) String
-  def arms([]) := ""
-  def arms([c | rest]) := arm(c) <> arms(rest)
-
-  def arm(Clause) String
-  def arm(Clause(pats, guard, body)) :=
-    "        " <> arm_pat(pats) <> guard_str(guard) <> " => " <> render(body) <> ",\n"
+  def arms(Vec(Clause), String, Vec(String)) String
+  def arms([], _, _) := ""
+  def arms([c | rest], ret, tvars) := arm(c, ret, tvars) <> arms(rest, ret, tvars)
+
+  def arm(Clause, String, Vec(String)) String
+  def arm(Clause(pats, guard, body), ret, tvars) :=
+    "        " <> arm_pat(pats) <> guard_str(guard) <> " => " <>
+      ret_coerce(render(body), ret, tvars) <> ",\n"
+
+  # a bare owned-tvar return (`-> T`) yields a borrowed `&T` in the base arms (a
+  # returned param), so `.clone()` it to the owned `T` the signature promises.
+  def ret_coerce(String, String, Vec(String)) String
+  def ret_coerce(s, ret, tvars)
+    if member(ret, tvars) do
+      "(" <> s <> ").clone()"
+    else
+      s
+    end
+  end
 
   # one pattern matches directly; N>1 a tuple pattern.
   def arm_pat(Vec(RPat)) String
